meta.source: Overture Maps buildings and places 2026-08-19.0 (ODbL), OpenStreetMap, Microsoft and Google footprints merged, Ras Al Khaimah extent, pulled 17 Sep 2026; plus houses digitised by PSD from imagery where the open sources have none
meta.houseRule: a house is a footprint between 40 and 1,500 square metres inside the nine sectors that is not classed as a garage, shed, commercial, industrial, public or agricultural building and does not stand inside one of the department's drawn commercial or industrial areas; smaller structures and other buildings are drawn but carry no bin
meta.binStandard: one 1,100 L bin per house (PSD, 14 Sep 2026)
meta.densityRule: drawn area density where a building is inside one, else the sector density (Sector 3 heavy, others normal)
meta.categoryRule: schools, hospitals, government, mosques, commercial and industrial buildings from the Overture building subtype and class, then from the Overture place standing in or within 40 m of the building; the place name is carried
meta.heightRule: source height where Overture carries one, else floors x 3.3 m + 1 m, else an estimate from the footprint and class at the upper end of the local stock: under 40 m2 3.5 m; houses under 120 m2 6 m (single storey with parapet and roof tanks), under 350 m2 9.5 m (G+1), under 800 m2 11.5 m (19 m in the dense city zones), larger 14 m (23 m dense); schools 13 m, hospitals 16 m (22 m over 2,500 m2), government 13 m, mosques 12 m, commercial 14 m, industrial 10 m, halls over 5,000 m2 11 m
meta.rowFormat: [areaIndex, areaM2, ring, heightM, kind, src, name, groundM, code, namedArea] with kind 0 house, 1 structure under 40 m2, 2 other, 3 education, 4 medical, 5 government and civic, 6 religious, 7 commercial, 8 industrial; src 0 open data, 1 digitised by PSD from imagery (unverified)

categories.label: Houses (one 1,100 L bin each; red where the density is heavy)

meta.note: estimate for planning; the bin survey of 4.1.9 replaces the house counts and a survey replaces the heights; digitised and swept buildings are unverified until surveyed

sourceClasses.1: digitised by PSD from imagery, reviewed one by one
sourceClasses.2: detected from imagery by the gap sweep of all nine sectors and accepted on a contact sheet review (77 of 412 rejected)

meta.ground: groundM is the ground elevation at the footprint centroid, metres above the ellipsoid, from the flood model's 50 m Copernicus GLO-30 grid (database/seeds/terrain_sectors_glo30_50m.csv.gz); null where the footprint lies beyond 100 m of the grid. Sampled by database/seeds/add_ground.py.
meta.codes: code at index 8 is provisional: the named collection area's sub sector and a sequence north to south then west to east (4B-0123), the sector where no named area covers the building (S4-0001), X where no sector does. namedArea at index 9 is the id in meta.namedAreas. Assigned by database/seeds/add_house_codes.py; not an asset register number.
meta.collegeRule: kind 9 (COL) is a former kind 3 building whose Overture place name reads as a university or college (university, college, academic centre, HCT, AURAK; not when the name says school); by name, REPORTED, until the next rebuild from the extracts applies the Overture category. Assigned by database/seeds/add_college_kind.py, 26 Sep 2026.
